fuel_cell.ref: No AP-42 factor; treated as negligible (assumption)

notes: Emissions = model dispatch in the peak year x heat rate x AP-42 factor.
PTE = installed MW x 8,760 h; a synthetic minor permit caps hours (or fuel) below the major-source line.
Engine factors include SCR and oxidation catalyst reductions (assumption: NOx -90%, CO -90%, VOC -50%).
